Gate queues on a productive round
This section sets out what is expected

Companion Animal Travel Desk standards. This section governs care, handling, and passenger support for animals traveling with Aurelia Skyways. The welfare coordinator reviews each case for comfort, cleanliness, and safe transfer. Staff must keep carriers secure, speak calmly, and give clear guidance to travelers. <<FACT F009>> A welcome team member must confirm documents, observe the animal, and route any concern to the welfare coordinator. <<FACT F021>> The desk must keep the lounge orderly, limit disruption, and maintain ready access for approved handlers. If an animal shows distress, staff must stop the process and arrange support at once. For quarantine matters, the responsible officer must follow station controls, maintain separation, and record the movement of each case. <<FACT F029>> Staff must not release any animal until checks are complete and the traveler has received final guidance. Contact the senior coordinator for exceptions, welfare concerns, or immediate operational support.
